text:
devon: saw a pattern on rack-9 this morning — multiple GPUs showing corrected ECC spikes then Xid 13/31 crashes within ~30s
maria: ugh, rack-9 again? which serials?
devon: S/Ns start with SGT42... ~8 cards in rack-9 and 3 in rack-11. telemetry shows repeated single-bit ECC corrections then machine exits
kai: VRM temps look noisy before the XIDs, +2-3°C spikes. NIC counters are fine.
sam: can we quarantine the nodes and run a stress test? don't want a rollout outage
devon: quarantined nodes and flagged in k8s: `kubectl annotate node rack9-n[1-8] infra/quarantine=true`
infra-bot: ALERT: GPU ECC correct rate > 15/hr on group=a100-rack9 (alert id: a100-ecc-spike-1767778888)
maria: paste a snippet of `nvidia-smi` when it happens
devon: logs from node rack9-n3:
```
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, PID=0, GPU=0
GPU 0 ECC errors corrected: 23
VRM temp: 86C -> 90C spike
```
kai: FW mismatch? which driver + firmware versions?
devon: driver 525.85, firmware 52.1.2, same fleet-wide except the SGT42 batch has vendor fw 52.1.2b (older)
ryan: vendor note: some batches shipped with solder flux residue causing intermittent contact under thermal cycling — we've seen similar with vendor X in 2023
sam: action plan proposal:
- drain affected nodes (one at a time) and mount to test bench
- run 48h memory+power cycle stress on SGT42 cards
- open RMA with vendor for affected serials
- add alert to trigger earlier on corrected-ECC spikes
maria: drain command snippet:
```
kubectl drain rack9-n3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
kai: temp mitigation: reduce GPU power limit by 10% for affected pool, see if ECC rate drops
devon: lowering power limit on rack9 pool now via ganglia script
sam: who can pick up vendor RMA? @maria take lead, @ryan to provide vendor contact and batch list
maria: on it. i'll open the ticket and request expedited RMA citing field failure
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2743 assigned to eng-infra (link)
ryan: add to postmortem: root cause likely manufacturing residue + thermal cycling; contributing factors: older vendor FW, no early ECC-rate alert
devon: also recommend telemetry changes:
- emit median-corrected-ecc per-card over 5m
- trigger soft-drain at threshold 15/hr
- tag serials with batch label in prometheus
maria: timeline: start rolling drains tonight 23:00 UTC; replace cards over next 3 days
sam: add runbook step for rapid quiesce: `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain` + `nv-hostengine` logs collected
devon: thanks all — i'll keep thread updated with test bench results :thumbsup:
